name: NVT Oikos
location: Pattandur Agrahara Village, K R Puram Hobli, Whitefield, Bengaluru East
tagline: An exclusive enclave of 28 Greek-inspired 4 BHK villas in Whitefield, Bengaluru
overview: NVT Oikos is an exclusive enclave of 28 4 BHK villas in Whitefield, Bengaluru's IT hub, drawing on classical Greek ideals of simplicity, proportion and harmony. Serene courtyards, stately columns and sunlit sky decks come together in a refined sanctuary that blends heritage with modern luxury.
highlights: Only 28 exclusive 4 BHK villas across basement + 3 floors
Terrace options for hobbies, relaxation or open-sky moments
Skylight with double-height ceiling above the library
Ornate balconies adding classical charm to every bedroom
Large-scale glass windows for natural light and ventilation
Private backyard attached to the living and dining areas
Dual elevation with green spaces at both front and back
Master bedroom with an adjoining private office
Private lift connecting the basement to all floors
Located in Whitefield, Bengaluru's established IT hub
amenities: Backup Power for Villas & Common Areas

items: RCC-framed structure with solid cement block masonry for internal and peripheral walls
Internal walls with smooth plaster finish and emulsion paint; external walls with waterproof plaster and exterior-grade emulsion paint

Imported marble for foyer, living, dining and staircase; vitrified tiles/granite for kitchen and utility; wooden laminate for bedrooms and family room; pressed clay tiles for terraces and anti-skid ceramic tiles for balconies and toilets
Ceramic glazed tile dado up to 7 ft, CP fittings and accessories, single-lever diverter for showers, health faucet, and provision for solar water heater and exhaust fans
Three-track UPVC/aluminium windows with clear glass
Good quality CP fittings, PVC pipes and storm-water drainage
Granite platform with stainless steel sink and drain board, ceramic glazed tile dado above the platform
Concealed copper wiring with modular switches, up to 10 KW power per villa with backup power of up to 5 KW, and provision for AC in all rooms
Teak wood frame main door with designer flush shutter; seasoned hardwood frame for other doors with stainless steel hardware

locationInfo.summary: Well connected to Whitefield's IT corridor, reputed schools, hospitals and shopping destinations, with Kadugodi Tree Park Metro Station and Whitefield Railway Station both a short drive away.

places: Novo Nordisk Global Business Services – 16 mins
Kadugodi Tree Park Metro Station – 5 mins
